name: MLX-LM on MacBook Pro 14-inch M3 Pro 18GB: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 4-bit generation throughput
methodology: PER-REQUEST generation throughput, 128 tokens generated after a 2048-token prompt, batch 1, 5 trials averaged (the PR states '5 trials, averages reported'). Command: mlx_lm.benchmark --model mlx-community/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507-4bit -p 2048 -g 128. Hardware: MacBook Pro 14-inch M3 Pro, 18GB unified memory, 18-core Neural Engine. Software: mlx 0.32.0, mlx-lm 0.31.3, macOS Sonoma 14.4. Same run reports prompt processing 615.28 tok/s and peak memory 3.30 GB; MMLU Pro 60.72. OMITTED BY SOURCE: GPU core count, sustained-load thermal behaviour (the significant omission for a laptop part), power limit, and whether the 5 trials were interleaved or sequential. This is a laptop APU in a chassis with a shared thermal envelope, unlike the M4 Max desktop rows.
notes: WEAKEST-SOURCED record in this slice and marked draft/0.45 accordingly: a community PR by one poster on a laptop, closed unmerged. Retained because it is the only non-desktop Apple-silicon decode datapoint and because it usefully bounds the low end - 44.62 tok/s for a 4B 4-bit model on an 18GB M3 Pro, versus ~126-135 tok/s for the same 4B model 4-bit on a 64GB M4 Max from a different (Apple-authored) source. That is a ~3x gap for what is nominally the same model and quantization, and it is the clearest evidence in this slice that unified-memory BANDWIDTH, not TOPS, sets Apple decode speed. The two figures are not strictly comparable (different mlx versions, different hosts, one a laptop under thermal pressure) and are flagged as such. ACCELERATOR ID CAVEAT: the repo has accelerators/apple-m3-max and apple-m3-ultra but NO apple-m3-pro record; apple-m3-max is referenced as the nearest existing id so the record resolves, but the silicon is an M3 Pro, not an M3 Max. A dedicated apple-m3-pro accelerator record should be created by whoever owns that slice and this reference corrected. The PR author also asserts 'accuracy is hardware-independent' re: the identical MMLU Pro score - that is a reasonable claim but was not independently checked here.
